title: Toward Evidence-Based Agentic Software Engineering
abstract: arXiv:2610.35348v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Task success rates and execution costs of agentic coding tools depend on both model and harness. The harness manages context, provides tools, and runs the agent loop. In empirical software engineering (SE) studies, comparisons that change model and harness together cannot isolate their effects. We qualitatively annotated 325 experiments reported in 146 peer-reviewed full papers published between 2025 and 2026. We examined the reported configurations and whether comparisons isolated harness effects, including harness configuration and version, model, tasks, and user interaction. The exact version of every harness used was reported for only 15 experiments. For five, the paper reported when the experiments were run, and for 31, authors shared execution traces for every session. translated_title: 迈向基于证据的智能体软件工程
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.35348v1 公告类型：新 摘要：智能体编码工具的任务成功率和执行成本同时取决于模型和运行框架。运行框架负责管理上下文、提供工具并运行智能体循环。在实证软件工程（SE）研究中，同时改变模型和运行框架的比较无法分离两者的各自影响。我们对2025年至2026年间发表的146篇同行评审全文论文中报告的325个实验进行了定性标注。我们考察了所报告的配置，以及这些比较是否分离了运行框架的影响，包括运行框架的配置与版本、模型、任务和用户交互。结果发现：仅有15个实验报告了所用运行框架的确切版本；只有5篇论文报告了实验运行的时间；31篇论文的作者分享了每个会话的执行轨迹；在比较运行框架的226个实验中，有35个从未单独改变运行框架这一变量。基于这一分析，我们推导出了一个参考运行框架所应满足的需求……
tldr: 本研究通过标注146篇论文中的325个实验，揭示智能体软件工程研究普遍缺乏对运行框架版本及配置的充分报告、且很少将运行框架影响与模型影响分离，并据此提出了参考运行框架的需求。
en_tdlr: By annotating 325 experiments across 146 peer-reviewed papers, this study shows that agentic software engineering research rarely reports harness details or isolates harness effects from model effects, and derives requirements for a reference harness.
